title: Ek Love Ya
desc: After getting rejected by a girl, Amar, a law student, becomes resentful. Years into the future, he is arrested for a crime that eventually leads him to her.

title: Snehana Preethina
desc: The rich fathers of Adi and Lakshmi hatch a plot to separate them from their poor respective lovers, Sindhu and Soorya. However, Adi soon realises the truth and decides to set things right.

title: My Autograph
desc: To invite his friends to his wedding, Shankar returns to his village. Along the way, nostalgic memories of his childhood and the bonds he left behind resurface.

title: Stunt Master
desc: Pooja, a college girl, does not believe in love. Her friends put forth a challenge that she should be friends with a man for thirty days without falling in love with him, but things go awry.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Kari Gooli
desc: After suffering mercilessly under the reign of a ruthless tycoon, the villagers find hope in a Jallikattu bull trainer, who locks horns with the tycoon.

title: Thavarina Siri
desc: Muttanna bravely navigates life's challenges to provide for his family while staying true to his humanitarian heart. Despite their struggles, he selflessly takes care of others.
